articles.title: Quench your thirst! 20 perfect spritzes and shandies to try now – from kumquat to portergaff
articles.summary: Whether you love a traditional spritz or tend towards a wilder libation, this August there are bubbly and sophisticated drinks to suit every taste. This summer, UK web searches for “Hugo spritz”, an elderflower-flavoured aperitif, overtook searches for “Aperol spritz” for the first time.
body: Traditionally, the spritz is an Italian cocktail made from prosecco, a bitter aperitif or liqueur, and a splash of soda water to keep things steady. While Venetian bartenders are more likely to judge it by eye, there is a simple 3-2-1 formula for making a spritz at home: three parts prosecco, two parts liqueur and one part soda water. I’ve gone with 75ml/50ml/25ml – keep the same ratios to make a smaller (60ml/40ml/20ml) or larger (90ml/60ml/30ml) drink. Of course, you can then adjust it to make it stronger or weaker (I have been known to leave out the soda …).

If wine-based cocktails aren’t to your taste, shandy is also showing signs of a resurgence – Ocado sales have increased 40% year on year, and the craft brand Shandy Shack is now stocked in M&S. Being half beer, half soft drink, it is another summery thirst-quencher that is easy to make at home and (in theory) shouldn’t get you too sloshed.
So, here are 20 simple spritzes and shandies. Save your Malibu for a piña colada.
All recipes make one drink. Pour the liquids into a large glass with ice, stir briefly and garnish.

articles.summary: Make the victim feel safe and able to talk at their own pace, and consider any danger the perpetrator currently presents to younger members of the family. A young adult woman in our family has recently shared that her older male cousin once touched her inappropriately when she was aged six and he…
body: She shared the story with her parents this year and the information was then shared with her cousin and other family members. He stated that he cannot recall either incident.

The young woman’s parents have raised whether her cousin is a now a threat to young children in the family. The parents were both victims of sexual abuse when they were children, which adds to the horror.

The story has completely shattered the entire wider family, which was once close. The young woman said she does not want an investigation. She has been encouraged to engage with counselling but has so far declined. Her cousin is accessing psychological support following mental health issues.

The whole family is appalled by the situation, the main concern being the young woman’s safety. Can you please advise on how we support them both – and help to repair the relationships. Or is this how it will be?

articles.title: Zoë Kravitz Experiments in a Long Misunderstood Denim Style
articles.summary: Harry Styles and Zoë Kravitz have a shared love of classic straight-leg jeans; but the actor strikes out in a more retro silhouette.
body: Zoë Kravitz knows good bottoms. Whether it’s The Row’s flowing Gala pants, Cou Cou Intimates bermudas, or the no-waistband style Still Here low-rider jeans, Kravitz has a regular rotation of contemporary classics that act as the foundation of her wardrobe. Now engaged to partner Harry Styles, the actor and her pop star husband-to-be have established they have a similar taste in denim: relaxed, usually straight-leg, deep blue.

Now back in New York before Styles takes on his mammoth 30-night residency at Madison Square Garden, Kravitz is experimented in a long maligned denim silhouette—one that Styles probably wouldn’t be up for incorporating into their coordinating couple style. Namely, a pair of light-wash blue cropped and kick flare jeans that sat ultra low on the waist.

articles.title: Let’s embrace French Sundays – the art of doing absolutely nothing | Polly Hudson
articles.summary: The idea of being deliberately unproductive is certainly tempting. The only concern is that you might enjoy it too much... They know what they’re doing when it comes to kissing, toast and horns, so get ready for a French Sunday.
body: Apparently in France the Sabbath really is a complete day of rest; not for the French any running of errands, cleaning or batch cooking. Rather than trying to do everything, they do nothing. And the hypothesis is that the French Sunday – or le dimanche français, as nobody is calling it – is transformative, and stamps out the Sunday Scaries for good.

A French Sunday is not a waste of a day, you’re not being slothful, you are staving off burnout and recharging. Instead of running yourself ragged trying to wring the most out of the weekend, you’re sleeping in, vegging out, relaxing, lolling, pottering, while thinking chic thoughts, or whatever. Perhaps reading a bit, although holding a book takes a lot of energy, so caution is advised.

The only potential pitfall with the French Sunday is enjoying it too much, climbing too enthusiastically on board and trying to extend it. Can’t imagine many bosses would approve a proposal to introduce a company-wide French Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, but, you know, God loves a trier. Bonne chance with that.
points: The idea of being deliberately unproductive is certainly tempting.
They know what they’re doing when it comes to kissing, toast and horns, so get ready for a French Sunday.

articles.title: My best ever British holiday: ‘I’ve travelled further, at greater expense, and had nothing like as much fun’
articles.summary: Five travel writers share their favourite holidays at home, from gravel biking in Scotland and a steam train ride in Yorkshire to rowing all the way from Oxford to London. One of my best UK holidays was the week I spent in June 2013 rowing from Oxford to London with two friends, James and Tom.
body: We hired the boat from a company called Thames Skiff Hire that mainly caters to people recreating the fictional adventure of the characters in Jerome K Jerome’s Three Men in a Boat. Our boat – Ewen – was a 26ft, 130-year-old mahogany skiff. It came with two pairs of oars, a rudder, a cooking stove, a boat hook, and iron hoops that supported a green canvas roof over the hull.

After an hour’s briefing at a slipway by Donnington Bridge, we were off, piloting the boat 80 or so miles downstream to London. That June was blustery and wet. The first day was deceptively fine, but on the second, we got soaked on the stretch of water between Abingdon and Day’s Lock, and came close to packing it in.

Even with the current helping us, the miles ahead seemed like folly. It’s not generally remembered that Jerome K Jerome’s Three Men in a Boat ends in disappointment and recrimination as the companions abandon their sodden skiff at The Swan in Pangbourne.
But we kept going. And, over the subsequent days, the weather improved, we got better at rowing and it turned into an extraordinary and memorable adventure.
points: Five travel writers share their favourite holidays at home, from gravel biking in Scotland and a steam train ride in Yorkshire to rowing all the way from Oxford to London.

articles.title: Ariana Grande and Ricky Álvarez Layer Up for an Even Harder Launch in London
articles.summary: In London for the Eternal Sunshine tour, Ariana Grande and boyfriend Ricky Álvarez are holding onto the last embers of British summertime, despite the temp.
body: The Eternal Sunshine tour has brought Ariana Grande to London for an ambitious 10-day residency. A city she’s long loved, of course Ari brought her rekindled flame Ricky Álvarez with her to enjoy the last embers of British summer.

While we’ve not hit a coordinating couple style rhythm just yet, they have proved their commitment to each other this time around with matching tattoos. During one of her first London shows, Grande debuted the script, “I do love you,” which sits just on her collarbone. It matches one that Alvarez has inked in a similar place.
There was a few months of speculation that Grande and Álvarez had reunited, with Grande coyly teasing their coupledom.
Grande and Álvarez became Instagram official last week, with a photo dump that featured several mirror selfies that showed them embracing.

articles.title: Harry Styles and Zoë Kravitz Propose Different Approaches to the Travel Outfit
articles.summary: Landing in New York ahead of the Together, Together residency at Madison Square Garden, Harry Styles and Zoë Kravitz take their touchdown looks seriously.
body: Sweatsuits and modular carry-alls in the airport just don’t cut it when you’re a celebrity with a suite of The Row’s flowing Gala pants or a gargantuan Chanel tote bag at your disposal. And when you’re as well-papped a couple as Harry Styles and Zoë Kravitz, you know the arrivals gangway is just as important a style moment as a stage or red carpet appearance.

Some of our first glimpses of Harry Styles and Zoe Kravitz were when they were traveling: blurry shots from Rome to Berlin, Los Angeles and London. Wherever they are, their couple style remains in sartorial lockstep, pared back (and powered by The Row) in tailored bottoms, easy denim, loafers, and a range of various slogan hats that they share. If we’re to take any lessons from their travel ’fits, it’s that all-black is a great hack and having the right foundations is key: a trusty trench coat and easily removed outer layer, comfy but chic shoes like a loafer, and timeless, minimalist, functional accessories.

articles.title: Kendall Jenner and Jacob Elordi’s Dating World Tour Continues in London
articles.summary: Following his solo appearance at “The Dog Stars” premiere, Jacob Elordi was joined by Kendall Jenner for a night on the town.
body: Coachella, Australia, Hawaii, Japan, Idaho, now London’s calling! Kendall Jenner and Jacob Elordi’s romance is unfurling across the globe. On Thursday night in the British capital, the model and actor made one of their first and most well-papped appearances yet.

Elordi stepped out earlier in the evening for the world premiere of Ridley Scott’s The Dog Stars, where he was joined on the red carpet by both co-stars: a bare-heeled Margaret Qualley and Rak Jasper the dog. Jenner joined him later, with the couple reportedly spending a few hours at the Dorchester Hotel’s China Tang restaurant and seeing the evening out into the early hours at Soho House.

The Wuthering Heights star stayed in his navy pinstriped Bottega Veneta suit and a pair of sunglasses, while Jenner, in similarly sleek shades, opted for a fitted gray pencil skirt dress, pointed black pumps, and a black Hermès bag.

A night previous, Elordi and Jenner enjoyed a more low-key date night, having a midweek meal with Elordi’s father at Cipriani. Both kept to their own relaxed and coordinating aesthetics: Elordi in a forest green track jacket and jeans, Jenner in a cobalt blue shirt, white tee, and black tailored pants.
